layout.label: Vial layout file
layout.description: Saved W-CORNE .vil export. Re-enable this plugin after replacing the export.
avoid_caret.label: Avoid typing cursor
avoid_caret.description: Prefer top center; move to bottom center when a supported app's typing cursor is nearby. Apps without caret reports use top center. Requires the accessibility service; Ghostty requires the experimental accessibility build.
position.label: Fixed position (cursor avoidance off)
monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.description: Use focused to follow the active monitor, leave empty for the compositor default, or enter a connector such as DP-2. A disconnected connector falls back to the compositor default.
margin.label: Edge margin (pixels)
always_visible.label: Always visible
always_visible.description: Show QWERTY while idle and follow held layers while typing. Preview overrides the displayed layer.
preview.label: Preview layer
preview.description: Keep a layer visible while adjusting placement. Turn off to return to held-key detection.
